name: Customer Analytics Minor
intro: At the heart of most modern organizations, such as Google, Amazon, Netflix and Facebook, lies a strong Customer Analytics function. Customer Analytics uses vast amounts of data to generate insights that help firms and policy makers to make data driven decisions about customers. Insights into customer behavior, attitudes, demographics and pyschographics can prove to be a sustainable advantage for firms.

notes: A minimum of 16 units (including BUAD 307 and MKT 402 ) must be unique to the minor (i.e., cannot be countable toward requirements for the student’s major).
At least 16 units of all courses taken for the minor are not offered by the student’s major department.
A minimum of 4 units must be taken from each of the two groups listed below.

groups.sub: Marketing Applications and Consumer Decision Making

courses.title: Analytics for Advertising and Social Media Campaigns
Marketing Capstone: From Strategy to Execution
